summary: Nano Dimension Ltd. filed an 8-K furnishing a notice of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders to be held July 31, 2026. Proposing shareholders Murchinson Ltd. et al. demanded the meeting seek a non-binding advisory vote on continuing management's strategic alternatives review process. The board recommends voting FOR. No stated price, premium, or other deal terms. The event signals potential pressure to pursue a sale or other transaction, making this equivalent to a US strategic review update/special meeting. Watch for further details on alternatives or an eventual transaction.
